Name: Lucien The Werewolf
Author: K1N0K0SSUP3RGAY
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Meet Lucien! The Broody werewolf thats hiding in the woods. He's rude and pretty cold at the beginning. But he will, always, get softer to you as you continue on his little story!

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Install Smapi! (you should already have this)
2. Install Content Patcher (you should have this already too!)
3. ALSO GET PORTRAITURE!!!!!!!!!!!!!
4. Come back to this page, click the download button, manual install and unzip the folder into your mods folder!
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
Includes Lucien, portraits made by me! and sprites made by me. The coding itself was written by me and a friend of mine. 
Lucien also has compatiblitiy with Stardew Expanded, Ridgeside and East Scarp
+ added support for PolyamorySweet! He has special dialogue for this too!
Also, Lucien comes with gender neutral tokens for all my non-binary farmers out there!
This is my first mod so if you see any bugs or dialogue errors, please make a bug report!

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]REMEMBER!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!1111[/b][/size]
Lucien is a STRICTLY 2 year npc, by that i mean you will not see him until year 2, IF you manage to get into the secret woods in year 1, he will not appear and his event will not work.
I reccommend Stardew Expanded and all its requirements! its one of my favorite mods! 
I also reccommend the Generic Mod config menu as well so you can change what Lucien calls you as you get closer!

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
Thank you to  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/279647863]yirehi[/url] who inspired me to make my own mod,  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/167786198]jayjaydub[/url] for the inspo again and Hanatsuki for the great gender neutral tokens and mods. To my friend Katie who told me to go for it and thanks to my dog who continually despised that i wasnt giving her attention :)
